GEOGRAPHY NOTE

HDB towns and URA planning areas are different geographies. Symbols use direct name matches as visual anchors; they do not imply that transactions were geocoded into those polygons. Central Area and Kallang/Whampoa appear in the ranking only.

WHAT THE FILES SUPPORT

Location context

Actual amenity point locations, planning boundaries, primary-school area counts, and observed town price differences.

WHAT NEEDS MORE DATA

A proximity premium

HDB block and school coordinates are missing. Nearest-amenity distances and accessibility price effects cannot be calculated from these uploads alone. Later snapshots also cannot reconstruct historic accessibility.

THE TAKEAWAY

Price is a combination.
Context makes it meaningful.

Compare the period, the property and the place together.
Use the visualizations to ask better questions—not to infer causation.
